$comment: The reviewer registry (shell/docs/decisions/ADR-0013-agent-config-is-the-registry.md): one entry per role, and nothing else restates it. A role with an agentFile keeps its instructions, pinned model ID, review header and token slug in that file. A role without one runs a superpowers prompt (instructions), so the controller's dispatch carries its token step, verdicts and headers from here, and model is a family alias. In headers, <model> is 'Claude ' plus the model the reviewer's system prompt names. Private keys: $HOME/.config/gcscode/gcscode-<role>.pem, or $GH_REVIEWER_APP_PRIVATE_KEY_DIR/gcscode-<role>.pem. How the roles are dispatched: the review-loop skill.

code-quality.trigger: after the task's spec-compliance review passes

final-review.trigger: end of iteration, right after gh pr ready

red-team.trigger: round 1 on every spec/ADR PR, then a fix check of each Code-review-followup

extension-architect.trigger: round 1, then fix checks only while its latest review has Blocking above 0
extension-architect.routing: product spec/ADR PRs that touch extension architecture; never agentic-process PRs
